dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose, you're here! Oh, is it time for the Expert exam already?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our alchemy skills are improving so fast, Paimon can barely keep up!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Your progress has been very impressive. In fact, according to the way Mr. Albedo designed the exams, passing the Expert level would mean you're now qualified to mentor other people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, we could start to teach other people?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then Paimon's totally going to start a class! Hmm, let's see, how much should Paimon charge per student...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, all Paimon knows right now is that, for homework, her students are gonna have to use alchemy to make all sorts of tasty treats, hehe. Paimon'll be sure to give them lots of feedback... on their alchemy skills, of course!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sure this one will go just as well as the others.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm ready to begin whenever you are. I'll be rooting for you!

choices.text: I still need a little more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Of course. This is the final exam. Take as much time to prepare as you need.

choices.text: Let's focus on the exam for now.
